$comment: Brain build configuration. `skills` selects from the flat skills/ dump by name, `category:<name>`, or `*`. `personas` selects from agents/ by name (abstract base personas are never emitted). Every skill a selected persona lists must be selected here. `self` adds brain-development artifacts for the self-injection build only.

self.$comment: Adjusts the product selection for the brain's own repository, used only by `npm run inject:self`. `add` carries the brain-development artifacts, which a project consuming the brain must never receive. `omit` drops roles the brain has no surface for.

omit.$comment: The brain has no mobile app and no public web surface: its only UI is one page on loopback. security-auditor is deliberately kept, because the brain handles credentials, reads local credential stores, serves HTTP, and has a privacy boundary on telemetry.
